# Actor Arsenal

> Professional web scraping actors for Apify. Business data, reviews, contacts, social media, directories — built for lead generation, local SEO, and market research.

Actor Arsenal is a collection of 60+ purpose-built Apify actors for extracting business data from the web. Each actor uses stealth browser technology (Camoufox) and residential proxies for reliable extraction.

## Actors

### Business Data
- Google Maps Scraper — Extract business listings, reviews, GBP data
- Yelp Scraper — Business profiles, reviews, photos
- BBB Scraper — Better Business Bureau profiles and complaints
- Yellow Pages Scraper — Business listings, phone numbers, addresses

### Contact Enrichment
- Company Contact Enricher — 8-source contact discovery
- LinkedIn Profile Scraper — Professional profiles and company data
- Tech Stack Detector — 50+ technology detection on any website

### Review Platforms
- Google Reviews Scraper — Full review extraction with responses
- Trustpilot Scraper — Reviews, ratings, company profiles
- G2 Scraper — Software reviews and comparisons

### Social Media
- TikTok Creator Scraper — Profile analytics, video data
- Instagram Scraper — Profiles, posts, engagement metrics
- Facebook Scraper — Pages, posts, reviews

### Directories
- Healthgrades Scraper — Doctor profiles and reviews
- Avvo Scraper — Lawyer profiles and reviews
- HomeAdvisor Scraper — Contractor listings
- Angi Scraper — Home service professionals

## Pricing

Pay-per-event pricing. Most actors charge $0.03–$0.08 per record scraped. Demo mode available on all actors (free, returns sample data).
